cases.name: eq_chamber
cases.sql: SELECT id, wafer_id, lot_id, chamber_id FROM v_anom_wafer WHERE chamber_id = ? ORDER BY id

cases.name: gte_date
cases.sql: SELECT id, stat_date, n, day_mean, n_over_ucl FROM v_day_flag WHERE stat_date >= ? ORDER BY stat_date

cases.name: lte_date
cases.sql: SELECT id, stat_date, day_mean FROM v_day_flag WHERE stat_date <= ? ORDER BY stat_date

cases.name: neq_chamber
cases.sql: SELECT id, chamber_id, win_n, win_anom_n FROM v_chamber_rate WHERE chamber_id <> ? ORDER BY chamber_id

cases.name: in_chambers
cases.sql: SELECT id, chamber_id, win_n, win_anom_n FROM v_chamber_rate WHERE chamber_id IN (?, ?) ORDER BY chamber_id

cases.name: not_in_chambers
cases.sql: SELECT id, chamber_id, win_anom_n FROM v_chamber_rate WHERE chamber_id NOT IN (?) ORDER BY chamber_id

cases.name: in_empty_is_false
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM v_chamber_rate WHERE 1 = 0 ORDER BY chamber_id

cases.name: like_lot_prefix
cases.sql: SELECT id, lot_id, anom_n FROM v_anom_lot WHERE lot_id LIKE ? ORDER BY lot_id

cases.name: like_underscore
cases.sql: SELECT id, stat_date, day_mean FROM v_day_flag WHERE stat_date LIKE '2026-09-__' ORDER BY stat_date

cases.name: page1
cases.sql: SELECT id, wafer_id, chamber_id, rs_ti_mean FROM v_anom_wafer ORDER BY wafer_id LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

cases.name: page2
cases.sql: SELECT id, wafer_id, chamber_id, rs_ti_mean FROM v_anom_wafer ORDER BY wafer_id LIMIT 200 OFFSET 200

cases.name: total_count_matches_pages
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS c FROM v_anom_wafer

cases.name: agg_baseline_moments
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(rs_ti_mean) AS sum_x, sum(rs_ti_mean * rs_ti_mean) AS sum_x2 FROM v_wafer_agg WHERE process_date < ?

cases.name: agg_chamber_comp
cases.sql: SELECT chamber_id, grp, n, sum_x, sum_x2 FROM v_chamber_comp ORDER BY chamber_id, grp

cases.name: agg_fdc_group
cases.sql: SELECT grp, n, sum_x, sum_x2 FROM v_fdc_group ORDER BY grp

cases.name: agg_fdc_corr
cases.sql: SELECT n, sum_x, sum_y, sum_xy, sum_x2, sum_y2 FROM v_fdc_corr

cases.name: traverse_anom_to_events
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.eqp_id, t.chamber_id, t.event_type, t.event_start FROM v_anom_wafer a JOIN dim_tool_event t ON a.chamber_id = t.chamber_id ORDER BY t.id

cases.name: traverse_with_source_filter
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.event_type FROM v_anom_wafer a JOIN dim_tool_event t ON a.chamber_id = t.chamber_id WHERE a.chamber_id = ? ORDER BY t.id

cases.name: combo_range_and_eq
cases.sql: SELECT id, stat_date, day_mean, n_over_ucl FROM v_day_flag WHERE stat_date >= ? AND n_over_ucl > ? ORDER BY stat_date DESC

cases.name: order_asc_limit
cases.sql: SELECT id, lot_id, anom_n, first_date FROM v_anom_lot ORDER BY anom_n DESC, lot_id ASC LIMIT 5
